paragraphs.source_en: Principles of Strong Product Teams 35 Team Size There’s no rule that says all product teams in a company need to be the same size. It’s true there is the notion of critical mass for a product team—usually one product manager, one designer, and two engineers. However, some teams might justify five engineers and two test automation engineers—others even more. There is a practical upper bound on a team, which usually works out to be around 8–12 engineers. You’ve probably heard about the two-pizza rule, which is intended to help keep teams in this range. More important than the absolute size of the team is the balance of skills needed to ensure we build the right things, and build those things right.
